description: This file defines the AndroidXmlCodeStyleSettings class and related nested classes, which customize XML formatting and style settings for Android development within the IntelliJ IDEA platform.

classes.name: AndroidXmlCodeStyleSettings
classes.description: Main class for Android-specific XML code style settings, including nested classes for different style configurations.

classes.name: MySettings
classes.description: Base class for XML style settings, supporting serialization, cloning, and equality checks.

classes.name: LayoutSettings
classes.description: Configures layout-related XML formatting options, such as inserting blank lines before tags.

classes.name: ManifestSettings
classes.description: Configures XML formatting for Android manifest files, including grouping tags with the same name.

classes.name: ValueResourceFileSettings
classes.description: Configures formatting for resource value files, including handling style tags and whitespace inside tags.

classes.name: OtherSettings
classes.description: Additional style settings with default wrapping and attribute insertion options.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of AndroidXmlCodeStyleSettings from CodeStyleSettings.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the AndroidXmlCodeStyleSettings object.

methods.name: readExternal
methods.description: Deserializes settings from an XML element.

methods.name: writeExternal
methods.description: Serializes settings into an XML element.

methods.name: createXmlPolicy
methods.description: Creates an XmlPolicy object based on current settings.
